=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:253-261 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The alternatives in the repeated `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` group overlap (`-[Cc]\s+\S+` vs `-[A-Za-z]`, and `--(?:git-dir|work-tree|namespace)\s+\S+` vs `--[A-Za-z][\w-]*(?:=\S+)?`). The group is spliced twice into `git_remote_op`, so input such as `git -c -c -c ... -c` with no remote subcommand after it backtracks exponentially.
  WHY: Instruction text that the model writes, and that prompt injection can shape, reaches `validate --sandbox-check` with no timeout (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1572). The judge then hangs until the job timeout, records no verdict, posts no `invalid_verdict` wait marker and logs no `UNBLOCK_JUDGE` line, and the item is redispatched each round. This regressed from the earlier linear regex. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputed that the finding reproduces.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:265-268 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `package_install` pattern misses common install commands: `pnpm add` (all four reviewers), `yarn add` (gemini, qwen), and `npm add`, `apt-get install`/`apt install`, `bun add|install` and `uv add|sync|pip install` (sonnet).
  WHY: A verdict that tells the implementer to run one of these commands passes the sandbox check and then fails in the implementer container, which has no network. This is the failure mode from fun-token-multi-chain#639. Severity is disputed: gemini, luna and qwen rated it MAJOR and sonnet rated it NIT. Sonnet also says `yarn add` is already caught, because `yarn(\s+install)?` matches a bare `yarn`.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:271 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `gh_cli` pattern is a fixed list of subcommands that misses `gh browse`, `gh copilot`, `gh gpg`, `gh ssh`, `gh extension`, `gh alias` and `gh config`. Gemini also lists `gh pr status`.
  WHY: Instructions that use a missing subcommand pass the sandbox check but fail in the implementer environment, which has no network, no `gh` CLI and no `gh` auth. Severity is disputed: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR and qwen rated it NIT. Sonnet rejected the claim: `gh pr` is already matched, and `\bgh\s+\S+` would wrongly refuse prose such as "gh is unavailable".
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: CLAUDE.md §19 must tell interactive sessions to use Implements #N for PRs implementing orchestrator item issues.
  expected_change_site: CLAUDE.md §19, after the blocker-bug bullet.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR contains no CLAUDE.md change. The requirement is explicitly deferred as IMPLEMENTS_MARKER_CLAUDE_MD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP in agents.d/7765-implements-marker.md. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus judged this deferred operator step not to be a gap, because pipeline editors cannot write CLAUDE.md.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:line 253, `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` (spliced into `git_remote_op` at lines 260-261; `_clean_text` lines 799-809, `MAX_TEXT = 1200`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The repeated group's alternatives overlap (`-c` as `-[A-Za-z]` or as `-[Cc]\s+\S+`; `--git-dir <v>` vs the generic `--[A-Za-z][\w-]*`). On "git -c -c ... -c" with no remote subcommand, backtracking grows like the Fibonacci numbers in the number of tokens; about 50 tokens means more than 1e10 steps, and about 399 tokens fit.
  WHY: Model `instructions` can carry prompt-injected text. `scripts/unblock_judge.sh` runs `unblock_py ... validate --sandbox-check` (`unblock_py` at line 122 is plain `python3 "$@"`) with no timeout, so the job hangs until the 45-minute timeout in `unblock_judge.yml`. No verdict, no `invalid_verdict` marker and no `UNBLOCK_JUDGE` line are produced, and the item is redispatched every round. This regressed from the last run. Fix: change `-[A-Za-z]` to `-(?![Cc]\b)[A-Za-z]` and the generic long option to `--(?!(?:git-dir|work-tree|namespace)\b)[A-Za-z][\w-]*(?:=\S+)?` (or bound the group with `{0,8}`), and add a test with about 300 " -c" tokens.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:lines 265-268, `package_install` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pattern misses `pnpm add`, `npm add`, `apt-get install`/`apt install`, `bun add|install` and `uv add|sync|pip install`. `yarn add` is already caught through the bare `yarn` match.
  WHY: A `retry_budget` or `descope` verdict such as "run apt-get install jq" passes `--sandbox-check`, and the fix-up fails in the network-less container (fun-token-multi-chain#639). Fix: add `npm\s+add|pnpm\s+add|apt(-get)?\s+install|bun\s+(add|install)|uv\s+(add|sync|pip\s+install)`.
- Rejected pass-1 claims (not reported): `git --no-pager log origin/main` does not match `git_remote_op`; it is refused only through `origin_ref`. `gh pr status` is matched by `\bgh\s+(...|pr|...)\b`. The rarely used `gh variable`, `gh project` and `gh browse` are unlisted, but `\bgh\s+\S+` would refuse prose, and no failing path was found.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The CLAUDE.md §19 `Implements #N` bullet is deferred as IMPLEMENTS_MARKER_CLAUDE_MD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP in agents.d/7765-implements-marker.md; a deferred requirement is not a gap.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, sandbox re-ask loop (`if unblock_py "${SUPPORT_DIR}/scripts/unblock_ledger.py" "${validate_args[@]}" > "${RUNTIME_DIR}/verdict.json"; then`). Prefix the call with `timeout 60`; rc 124 falls through to `invalid_verdict` (1 line). scripts/unblock_ledger.py line 253: add negative lookaheads or a `{0,8}` bound (1-2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4. (2 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:253 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` regex nests quantifiers (`\s+` inside a group repeated with `*`), which allows exponential backtracking on input like `git -c -c -c ... -c`.
  WHY: A crafted verdict can hang `validate --sandbox-check`, which stalls the judge job until the Actions timeout without a verdict or log line and so bypasses validation.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:271 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `gh_cli` pattern lists only some subcommands; `browse`, `copilot` and `pr status` are missing.
  WHY: Instructions that use an omitted `gh` subcommand pass the check but fail in the restricted container, which has no network and no `gh` auth.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:266 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `package_install` pattern omits `yarn add` and `pnpm add`.
  WHY: These commands pass the sandbox check but fail in a container that cannot reach package registries.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: CLAUDE.md §19 must tell interactive sessions to use Implements #N for PRs implementing orchestrator item issues.
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §19, after the blocker-bug bullet.
  Evidence of absence: The PR contains no CLAUDE.md change; the requirement is explicitly deferred as IMPLEMENTS_MARKER_CLAUDE_MD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP in agents.d/7765-implements-marker.md.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: line 253, bound the repetition with `{0,6}` (risk 3). Line 271, change to `r"\bgh\s+\S+"` (risk 1). Line 266, add `yarn\s+add|pnpm\s+add` (risk 1). scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 1553, wrap the `unblock_py` call in `timeout 60` (risk 3). (4 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:253, 259-261 (instructions capped at line 809, checked at lines 891-893; caller has no timeout at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1572) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` has overlapping alternatives for `-c` and other short options, so repeated `-c` tokens can be split in exponentially many ways while the regex backtracks looking for a remote subcommand that is not there.
  WHY: A model-produced `git -c -c -c ...` instruction can make regex evaluation slow even within the 1200-character limit. The judge waits on validation synchronously and can hang without recording a verdict or wait marker.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:266-268, `package_install` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pattern does not match `pnpm add <package>`.
  WHY: The instruction passes validation, and the fix-up then fails because the implementer has no registry access.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:271, `gh_cli` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fixed subcommand list does not match `gh browse`.
  WHY: The instruction passes validation, but the implementer environment has no `gh` CLI, so the fix-up fails.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:266-268, `package_install` pattern | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pattern matches `yarn(\s+install)?` and `pnpm\s+(install|i)` but not `yarn add <package>` or `pnpm add <package>`, which need registry access.
  WHY: A `retry_budget` verdict such as `yarn add axios` passes the check and fails in the network-less sandbox. This is the failure mode from fun-token-multi-chain#639.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:271, `gh_cli` pattern | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fixed list (`api|pr|issue|run|repo|release|workflow|label|auth|secret|search|status|gist|codespace`) misses `gh browse`, `gh copilot`, `gh gpg`, `gh ssh`, `gh extension`, `gh alias`, `gh config` and other subcommands.
  WHY: A verdict like `gh browse 123` passes the check and fails in the sandbox. Enumerating subcommands is inherently incomplete; suggests `\bgh\s+\S+`.
- Note: Qwen disputes the `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` backtracking finding. It says the alternatives are structurally distinct, the input is bounded by `MAX_TEXT = 1200`, and the worst case is linear. It also says `git --no-pager log origin/main` does not match `git_remote_op`.
- Note: Qwen says the CLAUDE.md §19 `Implements #N` item is not a gap. It is recorded as IMPLEMENTS_MARKER_CLAUDE_MD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP in `agents.d/7765-implements-marker.md`, because the implement pipeline cannot write `CLAUDE.md`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
